充分.es: Tienes una buena razón para estar enojado.

充分.zh: 我们有充分的理由相信这是真的。
充分.pinyin: Wǒ men yǒu chōng fèn de lǐ yóu xiāng xìn zhè shì zhēn de
充分.en: We have full reason to believe that it is true.

充分.pinyin: Tā chōng fèn lì yòng tā de jī huì
充分.en: He makes the most of his opportunities.

原则.zh: 那违背了我做人的原则。
原则.pinyin: Nà wéi bèi le wǒ zuò rén de yuán zé
原则.es: Eso va en contra de mis principios.

原则.zh: 在办公室吸烟违背我们的原则。
原则.pinyin: Zài bàn gōng shì xī yān wéi bèi wǒ men de yuán zé
原则.en: It's against the rules to smoke at the office.
原则.es: Fumar en la oficina está contra las reglas.

原则.pinyin: Wǒ huì hàn wèi wǒ de yuán zé
Tā bù huì wéi bèi tā de yuán zé
原则.en: He couldn't go against his principles.

影子.pinyin: Tā pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
影子.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.
影子.es: Tiene miedo de su propia sombra.

影子.pinyin: Tā hài pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
影子.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.
影子.es: Ella está asustada de su propia sombra.

影子.pinyin: Shù tóu xià cháng cháng de yǐng zi
影子.en: The tree cast a long shadow.
影子.es: El árbol proyectaba una larga sombra.

影子.pinyin: Shéi zài yǐng zi lǐ zàng zhe
影子.en: What is lurking in the shadows?

发言.zh: 通常女人都是最后发言有决定权的。
发言.pinyin: Tōng cháng nǚ rén dōu shì zuì hòu fā yán yǒu jué dìng quán de
发言.en: Women will have the last word.
发言.es: El hombre propone y la mujer dispone.

发言.zh: 总统作为一位真正的爱国者发言。
发言.pinyin: Zǒng tǒng zuò wéi yī wèi zhēn zhèng de ài guó zhě fā yán
发言.en: The president speaks as a real patriot.
发言.es: El presidente habla como un verdadero patriota.

发言.zh: 他发言完后，大家陷入了沉默。
发言.pinyin: Tā fā yán wán hòu dà jiā xiàn rù le chén mò
发言.en: When he finished speaking, everyone was silent.
发言.es: Cuando él terminó de hablar, todo el mundo estaba callado.

发言.pinyin: Tā tòu guò chuán yì yuán fā yán
发言.es: Ella habló por medio de un intérprete.

温柔.zh: 他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。
温柔.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de shǒu wēn róu de fàng zài tā de jiān shàng
温柔.en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
温柔.es: Él puso gentilmente su mano sobre su hombro.

温柔.zh: 我不需要你口头上的温柔。
温柔.pinyin: Wǒ bù xū yào nǐ kǒu tóu shàng de wēn róu
温柔.en: I don't need your verbal gentleness.

温柔.zh: 她给了他一个温柔的吻。
温柔.pinyin: Tā gěi le tā yī ge wēn róu de wěn
温柔.en: She gave him a tender kiss.

丑.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
丑.pinyin: Yī ge chǒu nán rén qiāo le wǒ de mén
丑.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.
丑.es: Un hombre feo llamó a mi puerta.

丑.zh: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
丑.pinyin: Nà ge chǒu nán rén zài jié shí zhè ge wǒ men zhī dào jiù hǎo
丑.en: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
丑.es: Entre tú y yo, el gordo feo está a dieta.

丑.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐ zi hěn chǒu

丑.zh: 不要等到人人都说你丑时才发现自己真的丑。
丑.pinyin: Bù yào děng dào rén rén dōu shuō nǐ chǒu shí cái fā xiàn zì jǐ zhēn de chǒu
丑.en: Do not wait until everyone says that you are ugly before realising that you really are ugly.

燃烧.pinyin: Zhè fáng zi zhèng zài rán shāo zhe

燃烧.zh: 硫磺燃烧著蓝色的火焰。
燃烧.pinyin: Liú huáng rán shāo zhe lán sè de huǒ yàn
燃烧.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
燃烧.es: El azufre se quema con una llama azul.

燃烧.pinyin: Sù liào bù yì rán shāo
燃烧.es: El plástico no se quema con facilidad.

燃烧.pinyin: Mù tou hěn róng yì rán shāo

总之.zh: 总之它是个很棒的派对。
总之.pinyin: Zǒng zhī tā shì gè hěn bàng de pài duì
总之.en: In short, it was a great party.

总之.zh: 总之，下一步是要决定我们下一步应该做什么。
总之.pinyin: Zǒng zhī xià yī bù shì yào jué dìng wǒ men xià yī bù yīng gāi zuò shén me
总之.en: In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.

总之.zh: 演讲者不熟悉他的主题，说得又不好，总之，他很糟糕。
总之.pinyin: Yǎn jiǎng zhě bù shú xī tā de zhǔ tí shuō de yòu bù hǎo zǒng zhī tā hěn zāo gāo
总之.en: The speaker didn't know his subject, nor did he speak well; in short, he was disappointing.

原料.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。
原料.pinyin: Sù liào dài tì le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de yuán liào
原料.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
原料.es: Los plásticos han reemplazado a muchos materiales convencionales.

原料.zh: 日本从国外进口各种原料。
原料.pinyin: Rì běn cóng guó wài jìn kǒu gè zhǒng yuán liào
原料.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
原料.es: Japón importa varias materias primas desde el extranjero.

原料.zh: 这座巧克力工厂每一天消耗二十公吨可可原料。
原料.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiǎo kè lì gōng chǎng měi yī tiān xiāo hào èr shí gōng dūn kě kě yuán liào
原料.en: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.

原料.pinyin: Rì běn yī lài jìn kǒu yuán liào
原料.en: Japan depends on imports for raw materials.

指挥.en: Take control of the command post.
指挥.es: Toma el control del puesto de mando.

指挥.zh: 狮子听从驯兽师的指挥。
指挥.pinyin: Shī zǐ tīng cóng xùn shòu shī de zhǐ huī
指挥.en: The lion followed the trainer's commands.

耳环.zh: 这对耳环是祖母送给我的。
耳环.pinyin: Zhè duì ěr huán shì zǔ mǔ sòng gěi wǒ de
耳环.en: I got these earrings from my grandmother.
耳环.es: Yo obtuve estos aretes de mi abuela.

耳环.zh: 汤姆把这对耳环给了我。
耳环.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ zhè duì ěr huán gěi le wǒ
耳环.en: Tom gave these earrings to me.

启发.zh: 他们的评论很有启发性。
启发.pinyin: Tā men de píng lùn hěn yǒu qǐ fā xìng

启发.zh: 我们对史密斯先生杰出的，给人启发的讲话表示感激。
启发.pinyin: Wǒ men duì shǐ mì sī xiān sheng jié chū de gěi rén qǐ fā de jiǎng huà biǎo shì gǎn jī
启发.en: We express our gratitude for Mr Smith's outstanding, challenging speech.

孝顺.zh: 世上有两件事不能等：一、孝顺 二、行善。
孝顺.pinyin: Shì shàng yǒu liǎng jiàn shì bù néng děng yī xiào shùn èr xíng shàn
孝顺.en: There are two things in the world that cannot wait: 1. Filial piety, 2. Doing good.

试图.pinyin: Shì tú táo pǎo shì méi yǒu yòng de
试图.en: It is no use trying to escape.
试图.es: No tiene caso tratar de escapar.

试图.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
试图.pinyin: Tā shì tú yóu guò hé dàn shì shī bài le
试图.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
试图.es: Él intentó cruzar el río a nado pero fracasó.

试图.zh: 当你试图去证明某件事，先知道它是真的会有所帮助。
试图.pinyin: Dāng nǐ shì tú qù zhèng míng mǒu jiàn shì xiān zhī dào tā shì zhēn de huì yǒu suǒ bāng zhù
试图.en: When you're trying to prove something, it helps to know it's true.
试图.es: Cuando intenta probar algo, ayuda saber que es verdad.

清理.pinyin: Wǒ qīng lǐ le zhuō zi

清理.zh: 我太太刚刚清理了桌子。
清理.pinyin: Wǒ tài tai gāng gang qīng lǐ le zhuō zi
清理.en: My wife has just cleared the table.
清理.es: Mi esposa acaba de limpiar la mesa.

清理.pinyin: Wǒ děng yī xià jiāng qīng lǐ chú fáng
清理.en: I'll clean up the kitchen later.

清理.zh: 你必须把桌子清理干净。
清理.pinyin: Nǐ bì xū bǎ zhuō zi qīng lǐ gān jìng

俗话.zh: 俗话说：浪子回头金不换；可俗话又说：狗改不了吃屎！
俗话.pinyin: Sú huà shuō làng zǐ huí tóu jīn bù huàn kě sú huà yòu shuō gǒu gǎi bù liǎo chī shǐ
俗话.en: The saying goes: to turn a new leaf is priceless. The saying also goes: a dog can't change their habits of eating shit!

代价.pinyin: Zì yóu shì yǒu dài jià de

代价.zh: 他想要成功，即使是以他的健康作为代价。
代价.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yào chéng gōng jí shǐ shì yǐ tā de jiàn kāng zuò wéi dài jià
代价.en: He wanted to succeed, even at the cost of his health.
代价.es: Él quería triunfar aún a costas de su salud.

代价.pinyin: Gōng zhèng de dài jià hěn gāo
Tāng mǔ míng bai shēng cún de dài jià
代价.en: Tom understands what it takes to survive.
代价.es: Tom entiende lo que se requiere para sobrevivir.

品质.zh: 这里卖的鲑鱼是品质最好的。
品质.pinyin: Zhè lǐ mài de guī yú shì pǐn zhì zuì hǎo de
品质.en: The quality of salmon being sold here is the best.
品质.es: El salmón que se vende aquí es de la mejor calidad.

品质.zh: 这里卖的三文鱼是品质最好的。
品质.pinyin: Zhè lǐ mài de sān wén yú shì pǐn zhì zuì hǎo de
品质.en: The quality of salmon being sold here is the best.
品质.es: El salmón que se vende aquí es de la mejor calidad.

品质.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
品质.pinyin: Zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
品质.en: The quality of these products is the same.

品质.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu pǐn zhì hǎo yī diǎn de ma
品质.en: Have you got anything that's better quality?

剑.zh: 我的剑虽然是钝的，但应付你的话是绰绰有余的。
剑.pinyin: Wǒ de jiàn suī rán shì dùn de dàn yìng fu nǐ de huà shì chuò chuò yǒu yú de
剑.en: My sword may be blunt, but that's more than enough for someone like you.
剑.es: Puede que mi espada esté roma, pero es más que suficiente para alguien como tú.

不止.zh: 不止你， 连我也被牵连了。
不止.pinyin: Bù zhǐ nǐ lián wǒ yě bèi qiān lián le
不止.en: Not only you but also I was involved.
不止.es: No solo eres tú, también yo fui involucrado.

不止.pinyin: Shāng kǒu liú xuè bù zhǐ
不止.en: The wound will not stop bleeding.
不止.es: La herida no para de sangrar.

不止.zh: 觉得汤姆肥的人不止我一个。
不止.pinyin: Jué de tāng mǔ féi de rén bù zhǐ wǒ yī ge
不止.en: I'm not the only one who thinks Tom is overweight.

不止.zh: 她不止嘲笑了他，还把他赶了出去。
不止.pinyin: Tā bù zhǐ cháo xiào le tā hái bǎ tā gǎn le chū qù
不止.en: She not only ridiculed him, but also drove him out.

偏见.zh: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。
偏见.pinyin: Wǒ duì wài jí yuán gōng méi yǒu piān jiàn
偏见.en: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.
偏见.es: No tengo prejuicios en contra de los trabajadores extranjeros.

偏见.zh: 你似乎对来自国外的想法有偏见。
偏见.pinyin: Nǐ sì hū duì lái zì guó wài de xiǎng fǎ yǒu piān jiàn
偏见.en: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
偏见.es: Pareces tener prejuicios contra las ideas que provienen de otros países.

偏见.pinyin: Tā duì wài guó rén yǒu piān jiàn
偏见.en: He has a prejudice against foreigners.

扑.zh: 我饿得跟饿虎扑羊似的。
扑.pinyin: Wǒ è de gēn è hǔ pū yáng shì de
扑.en: I'm as hungry as a horse.

扑.zh: 他们同心协力地把火扑熄了。
扑.pinyin: Tā men tóng xīn xié lì de bǎ huǒ pū xī le
扑.en: They worked together to put out the fire.
扑.es: Trabajaron juntos para apagar el fuego.

扑.pinyin: Huǒ mǎ shàng jiù bèi pū xī le
扑.en: The fire was extinguished at once.

扑.zh: 法国队守门员扑到地上截住了罗纳尔多的射门。
扑.pinyin: Fǎ guó duì shǒu mén yuán pū dào dì shang jié zhù le luó nà ěr duō de shè mén
扑.en: The goalkeeper for France dived to the ground and saved Ronaldo’s shot.
扑.es: El portero de Francia se tiró al suelo y paró el disparo de Ronaldo.

岁月.zh: 十年是一段漫长的岁月。
岁月.pinyin: Shí nián shì yī duàn màn cháng de suì yuè
岁月.en: Ten years is a really long period of time.
岁月.es: Diez años es realmente un largo tiempo.

岁月.zh: 二十年是一段漫长的岁月。
岁月.pinyin: Èr shí nián shì yī duàn màn cháng de suì yuè
岁月.en: Twenty years is a long time.
岁月.es: Veinte años es un largo tiempo.

岁月.zh: 她怀念自己的青春岁月。
岁月.pinyin: Tā huái niàn zì jǐ de qīng chūn suì yuè
岁月.en: She pines for the days of her youth.

天然气.pinyin: Tiān rán qì de jià gé shàng shēng
天然气.en: The price of gas is rising.
天然气.es: El precio de la gasolina sube.

天然气.zh: 煤和天然气是天然燃料。
天然气.pinyin: Méi hé tiān rán qì shì tiān rán rán liào
天然气.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
天然气.es: El carbón y el gas natural son combustibles naturales.

天然气.zh: 你们做饭用天然气还是用电？
天然气.pinyin: Nǐ men zuò fàn yòng tiān rán qì hái shi yòng diàn
天然气.en: Do you cook by gas or electricity?

天然气.zh: 你煮饭用天然气还是电力？
天然气.pinyin: Nǐ zhǔ fàn yòng tiān rán qì hái shi diàn lì
天然气.en: Do you cook by gas or electricity?

正宗.pinyin: Fǎ guó yǒu zhèng zōng de zhōng cān ma
正宗.en: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?

进攻.pinyin: Tā men jìn gōng le dí rén
Jìn gōng shì zuì hǎo de fáng yù
进攻.en: Attack is the best form of defense.
进攻.es: La mejor defensa es un buen ataque.

进攻.pinyin: Dí rén cóng běi biān jìn gōng
进攻.en: Enemies are approaching from the north side!

进攻.zh: 裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。
进攻.pinyin: Cái pàn gēn jù yǒu lì yuán zé jǔ qǐ shǒu shì yì jì xù jìn gōng
进攻.en: The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.

仁慈.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo rén jiā fēi cháng rén cí
仁慈.en: The old man is very kind.
There's no need to be gentle.

仁慈.pinyin: Wǒ yù dào de rén dōu hěn rén cí
仁慈.en: The people whom I meet are kind.

仁慈.zh: 我深深地被她的仁慈所感动。
仁慈.pinyin: Wǒ shēn shēn de bèi tā de rén cí suǒ gǎn dòng
仁慈.en: I was greatly moved by her kindness.

向往.zh: 我向往着和她一起看那部电影。
向往.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng wǎng zhe hé tā yī qǐ kàn nà bù diàn yǐng
向往.en: I'm looking forward to seeing the film with her.
向往.es: Espero con ganas a ver la película con ella.

向往.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǎng xìng fú

向往.zh: 没有什么可以阻挡，我对自由的向往。
向往.pinyin: Méi yǒu shén me kě yǐ zǔ dǎng wǒ duì zì yóu de xiàng wǎng
向往.en: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.

揭露.zh: 我更喜欢寻求问题的解决方法，而不仅仅是揭露它们。
揭露.pinyin: Wǒ gèng xǐ huan xún qiú wèn tí de jiě jué fāng fǎ ér bù jǐn jǐn shì jiē lù tā men
揭露.en: I prefer to look for a solution to problems, not only to report them.
揭露.es: Prefiero buscarle solución a los problemas, no sólo denunciarlos.

揭露.zh: 这种秘密总有一天会被揭露的。
揭露.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mì mì zǒng yǒu yī tiān huì bèi jiē lù de
揭露.en: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.

揭露.zh: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。
揭露.pinyin: Zhèng zhì jiā yǐ jiē lù zhèng fǔ guān yuán de fǔ bài lái tuī dòng gǎi gé
揭露.en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.

支撑.zh: 日本的经济是由一群勤奋工作的大城市上班族支撑起的。
支撑.pinyin: Rì běn de jīng jì shì yóu yī qún qín fèn gōng zuò de dà chéng shì shàng bān zú zhī chēng qǐ de
支撑.en: Japan has an economy that is supported by hard-working company employees in big cities.
支撑.es: Japón tiene una economía que está soportada por empleados de compañías que trabajan duro en las grandes ciudades.

边界.zh: 我很讨厌没有边界感的人。
边界.pinyin: Wǒ hěn tǎo yàn méi yǒu biān jiè gǎn de rén
边界.en: I don't like people who have no sense of boundaries.

边界.zh: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。
边界.pinyin: Hán guó suí zhe cháo xiǎn de wài huàn ér zài biān jiè fù jìn jí jié jūn duì
边界.en: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.

迫害.pinyin: Zhèng zhì pò hài kāi shǐ le
迫害.es: La cacería de brujas ha comenzado.

迫害.zh: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。
迫害.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn shòu dào bào jūn de pò hài yīng xióng hái wán qiáng de dòu zhēng
迫害.en: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
迫害.es: A pesar del acoso del tirano, el héroe prosiguió valientemente la pelea.

迫害.pinyin: Tā men shòu dào pò hài

便利.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
便利.pinyin: Zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
便利.en: The house has all the conveniences.
便利.es: La casa tiene todas las comodidades.

便利.zh: 我们的房子位於交通便利的地方。
便利.pinyin: Wǒ men de fáng zi wèi yú jiāo tōng biàn lì de dì fang

便利.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。

容貌.pinyin: Tā de róng mào gǎi biàn le xǔ duō

容貌.zh: 早睡早起对你的健康和容貌都很有好处。

容貌.en: Going to bed early and waking up early is very good both for your health and appearance.

容貌.zh: 要说容貌，她不比她姊姊难看。
容貌.pinyin: Yào shuō róng mào tā bù bǐ tā zǐ zǐ nán kàn
容貌.en: In terms of appearance, she's not any worse than her sister.

凝固.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
凝固.pinyin: Shuǐ ní huì zài shǔ gè xiǎo shí nèi níng gù
凝固.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
凝固.es: El cemento fraguará en un par de horas.

驱逐.zh: 许多犹太人被德国人驱逐。
驱逐.pinyin: Xǔ duō yóu tài rén bèi dé guó rén qū zhú
驱逐.en: Many Jews were expelled by the Germans.
驱逐.es: Muchos judíos fueron deportados por los alemanes.

不得已.zh: 这不是我们的错……大家都是逼不得已才这么做。
不得已.pinyin: Zhè bu shì wǒ men de cuò dà jiā dōu shì bī bù dé yǐ cái zhè me zuò
不得已.en: It wasn't our fault... We all had to do it.
不得已.es: No fue culpa nuestra... todos tuvimos que hacerlo.

反面.zh: 你把书拿反了，这是反面，这才是正面。

反面.en: You're holding the book upside-down. This is upside-down and this is right-side up.

情理.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù hé qíng lǐ

情理.es: Lo que dice no tiene ningún sentido.

斑.zh: 我给汤姆买了把斑卓琴作圣诞礼物。

跑.pinyin: Gǒu xiàng zhe wǒ páo le guò lái

跑.zh: 有一天，我会跑得像风一样快。
跑.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān wǒ huì páo de xiàng fēng yī yàng kuài
跑.en: Someday I'll run like the wind.
跑.es: Algún día correré como el viento.

跑.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén páo zài tā qián miàn
跑.en: No one ran ahead of him.

跑.zh: 那个学生跑得很快，不是吗？
跑.pinyin: Nà ge xué sheng páo de hěn kuài bù shì ma

那样.zh: 如果我可以像那样的话..。
那样.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ kě yǐ xiàng nà yàng de huà
那样.en: If I could be like that...

那样.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

那样.en: We will only consent on that condition.

那样.zh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。
那样.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé yī ge xiàng tā nà yàng de nǚ hái jié hūn
那样.en: I want to marry a girl like her.
那样.es: Me quiero casar con una hija como ella.

那样.zh: 他就是那样脱离危险的。
那样.pinyin: Tā jiù shì nà yàng tuō lí wēi xiǎn de
那样.en: That is how he got out of danger.
那样.es: Y así fue como se salvó del peligro.

她们.es: Él estiró el cuello un poco esperando oír lo que estaban susurrando.

过来.pinyin: Gǒu xiàng zhe wǒ páo le guò lái

过来.pinyin: Yǒu gè jǐng chá zǒu le guò lái
过来.en: A policeman came up to me.

过来.pinyin: Mǎ shàng guò lái jiàn wǒ
过来.en: Come and see me right now.

过来.zh: 她一见到我就马上跑了过来。
过来.pinyin: Tā yī jiàn dào wǒ jiù mǎ shàng páo le guò lái

德语.en: I cannot speak English, much less German.
德语.es: No puedo hablar Inglés, y mucho menos alemán.

德语.pinyin: Wǒ bù huì shuō fǎ yǔ yě bù huì shuō dé yǔ
德语.en: I can't speak French or German.
德语.es: No hablo ni francés ni alemán.

箱子.pinyin: Tā zhǎo dào de xiāng zi shì kōng de

箱子.zh: 这箱子是空的，里面什么也没有。

借给.es: Si quieres este bolígrafo, te lo dejo.

旅馆.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn dāi zài lǚ guǎn lǐ

旅馆.es: Estoy planeando quedarme en el hotel.

旅馆.en: Take a taxi to the hotel.

旅馆.en: The rooms in this hotel are not as clean as the rooms in that hotel.
旅馆.es: Las habitaciones de este hotel no están tan limpias como las de aquél.

旅馆.zh: 我不想和一个陌生人分享旅馆房间。
旅馆.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng hé yī ge mò shēng rén fēn xiǎng lǚ guǎn fáng jiān
旅馆.en: I don't want to share the hotel room with a stranger.
旅馆.es: No quiero compartir la habitación del hotel con un desconocido.

每次.zh: 我每次见到你就会想起你的母亲。
每次.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì jiàn dào nǐ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ nǐ de mǔ qīn
每次.en: Every time I see you, I think of your mother.
每次.es: Cada vez que te veo, pienso en tu madre.

每次.zh: 我每次读这本书都会有新发现。
每次.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì dú zhè běn shū dū huì yǒu xīn fā xiàn
每次.en: Every time I read this book, I find something new.
每次.es: Cada vez que leo este libro descubro algo nuevo.

每次.zh: 我每次听这首歌都会听到哭。
每次.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì tīng zhè shǒu gē dū huì tīng dào kū
每次.en: Every time I listen to this song, I cry.
每次.es: Lloro cada vez que escucho esta canción.

每次.zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。
每次.pinyin: Nǐ měi cì dōu jì xù fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù
每次.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
每次.es: Continúas cometiendo los mismos errores una vez tras otra.

有的.zh: 有的人是好的，有的人是坏的。
有的.pinyin: Yǒu de rén shì hǎo de yǒu de rén shì huài de
有的.en: Some people are good, some people are bad.
有的.es: Algunas personas son buenas, algunas son malas.

有的.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jǐn yǒu de yī běn shū
有的.en: This is the only book I have.
有的.es: Ese es el único libro que tengo.

有的.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。
有的.pinyin: Yǒu de kē xué jiā rèn wéi wēn shì xiào yìng shì xū gòu de
有的.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
有的.es: Algunos científicos creen que el efecto invernadero es imaginario.

有的.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
有的.pinyin: Lǐ lùn shàng shuō lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn méi yǒu qū bié dàn shí jiàn shàng shuō shì yǒu de

有的.es: En teoría, no hay ninguna diferencia entre la teoría y la práctica. Pero en la práctica sí.

金.es: El diamante fue colocado en un anillo de oro.

小孩子.zh: 你难以理解女人和小孩子对你说的话吗？

小孩子.en: Do you have difficulty understanding what women or small children say to you?
小孩子.es: ¿Tiene dificultades para comprender lo que le dicen mujeres o niños pequeños?

小孩子.zh: 我不喜欢给人当成小孩子般看待。
小孩子.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan gěi rén dàng chéng xiǎo hái zi bān kàn dài
小孩子.en: I don't like being treated like a child.
小孩子.es: No me gusta que me traten como a un niño.

小孩子.zh: 即使是一个小孩子都能理解。
小孩子.pinyin: Jí shǐ shì yī ge xiǎo hái zi dōu néng lǐ jiě
小孩子.en: Even a child can understand that.
小孩子.es: Eso lo puede entender hasta un niño.

小孩子.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ méi jǐ ge xiǎo hái zi
小孩子.en: There were few children in the room.
小孩子.es: Había pocos niños en la habitación.

进去.zh: 这个男孩从窗户进去了。

进去.es: El niño entró por la ventana.

进去.pinyin: Wǔ diǎn zhōng nǐ de xìn gǎn kuài tóu jìn qù hái lái de jí
进去.en: It's five o' clock. If you quickly post your letter, it still might make it in time.
进去.es: Son las cinco en punto. Si echas pronto tu carta al correo, aún puede que entre en tiempo.

不适.pinyin: Zhè shí wù bù shì gě wǒ
不适.en: This food does not agree with me.
不适.es: Esta comida no me sienta bien.

不适.en: I can't live that kind of life.

想像.en: I can't imagine life without you.

挑.es: Jack siempre le encuentra defectos a los demás. Es por eso que todos lo evitan.

村.pinyin: Tā de cūn wū zài hǎi àn shàng
